name: Quantum Wizard Chess 3D
description: Interactive 3D Gothic Cathedral Wizard Chess with a six-board Hyperfold tesseract: the same live board folded into a cube around an Apex Singularity black hole, hidden apex cones, 4D gravitational lensing and levels that climb from inside the tesseract to its exterior. Plus Hodge Cage force fields, supersonic sonic booms, decoherence scalars and quantum entanglement.
